title: Stave Control Contract v1
description: Contract schema for ctrl.v1 controls (safety rules). Each control defines an unsafe condition that Stave evaluates against observation snapshots.

controlType.title: Control Check Type
controlType.description: Category of safety check this control performs.

predicateRule.title: Predicate Rule
predicateRule.description: A single predicate rule that tests an asset field, or a nested logical group of rules.

field.title: Field Path
field.description: Dot-separated field path to evaluate on the asset (e.g., properties.public, properties.acl.grants).

op.title: Comparison Operator
op.description: Comparison operator to apply between the field value and the target value.

value.title: Comparison Value
value.description: Literal value to compare against. Type depends on the operator (boolean, string, number, array, etc.).

value_from_param.title: Parameter Reference
value_from_param.description: Name of a parameter in the control's params object whose value is used instead of a literal value.

any.title: Any Match Rules
any.description: Nested OR logic: at least one child rule must match for this group to match.

all.title: All Match Rules
all.description: Nested AND logic: all child rules must match for this group to match.

predicate.title: Unsafe Predicate
predicate.description: Top-level predicate defining unsafe conditions using logical combinators (any/all).

any.title: Any Match Rules
any.description: OR logic: at least one rule must match for the predicate to hold.

all.title: All Match Rules
all.description: AND logic: all rules must match for the predicate to hold.

canonicalControl.title: Canonical Control
canonicalControl.description: A complete control definition including metadata, predicate logic, and optional remediation guidance.

id.title: Control ID
id.description: Unique control identifier following the naming convention (e.g., CTL.STORAGE.PUBLIC.001).

name.title: Control Name
name.description: Short human-readable name summarizing what the control checks.

description.title: Control Description
description.description: Detailed explanation of the unsafe condition this control detects.

defect.title: Defect (authored)
defect.description: Authored prose describing what specifically is misconfigured when this control fires. Follows Zeller's failure-theory chain (defect → infection → failure) for technical triage output. Optional; empty or absent produces rendering that skips the defect section.

infection.title: Infection (authored)
infection.description: Authored prose describing how the defect propagates to enable adverse behavior. Plain mechanism language aimed at engineers triaging findings.

failure.title: Failure (authored)
failure.description: Authored prose describing the worst-case outcome if the infection is exploited. Adopter-meaningful terms (data exposure, credential-boundary collapse, cluster compromise), not abstract CVSS categories.

archetype.title: Archetype
archetype.description: Structural defect classification (e.g. 'ghost-reference', 'confused-deputy'). Optional; consumed by `stave expand` to surface every control sharing the same defect shape across services.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Whether the control's predicate reasons over a single asset (atomic) or across multiple related assets (compound). Orthogonal to `classification` (which names predicate shape: state_assertion/parameterized_check/absence_check/aggregate_check). Compound is Stave-distinctive territory — cross-resource attack patterns that per-resource framework checks miss by construction. Optional today; future iterations may enforce that compound controls also carry `corpus_reference`. See docs/control-classification-baseline.md for the per-domain breakdown.

corpus_reference.title: Corpus Reference
corpus_reference.description: Citation to the real-world attack pattern this control detects. Required when scope=compound (enforced by the build-time validator). Prefix-schema strings recommended: `MITRE:T1078.004`, `incident:capital-one-2019`, `stratus:aws.persistence.iam-create-admin-user`, `hackerone:1234567`, `csa:top-threats-2024:t1`, `rhino:iam-passrole-to-ec2`, `triz:<contradiction-id>`. Free-text accepted; the recommendation is for grep-ability.

intent_rationale.title: Intent Rationale
intent_rationale.description: Authored prose stating WHY this control exists — the security invariant it preserves. Distinct from `description` (what the control checks). The rationale flows into the SIR's ControlFact.intent_rationale field so an external solver / AI agent can reason about whether a violation matters in context, not just whether the predicate matched. Optional; absent rationale renders as empty in SIR exports.

forbidden_state.title: Forbidden State
forbidden_state.description: High-level logical condition that must NEVER be satisfied (e.g., principal=='*' AND network==public). Distinct from `unsafe_predicate`: the unsafe predicate triggers a finding when matched against an asset; the forbidden_state is an invariant the control declares the system must uphold and surfaces verbatim into SIR.ControlFact.forbidden_state for solver-side invariant checking. Reuses the same predicate shape so authors can express forbidden states with the same vocabulary they already know.

version.title: Control Version
version.description: Optional control document version marker used by curated packs.

domain.title: Control Domain
domain.description: Optional domain label for grouping controls (e.g., exposure, governance, access).

scope_tags.title: Scope Tags
scope_tags.description: Optional tags describing applicability scope (e.g., aws, s3, prod). Authoring metadata used for selector filtering and vendor pre-indexing; not an evaluation gate. See applicable_asset_types for asset-type gating.

applicable_asset_types.title: Applicable Asset Types
applicable_asset_types.description: Asset types this control evaluates. When present, the engine skips the control silently for assets whose type is not in this list (no finding, no trace, no tally entry). When absent, the control fires on all asset types (legacy behavior). Asset type values come from the observation contract (e.g., aws_s3_bucket, aws_iam_role, aws_kms_key).

type.title: Check Type
type.description: Category of safety check (e.g., unsafe_state, authorization_boundary).

classification.title: Semantic Classification
classification.description: Semantic role of the control's evaluation — distinct from `type` (engine-level mechanism) and `domain` (asset class). Lets downstream consumers filter findings by what the control actually checks: state_assertion (asset state matches an unsafe value); parameterized_check (asset state is unsafe relative to a parameterized threshold); absence_check (required evidence is missing); aggregate_check (compound or recurrence-based condition). Required so consumers can rely on the field existing without silent defaults; new controls declare it explicitly.

severity.title: Severity Level
severity.description: Severity level assigned to violations of this control.

compliance.title: Compliance Framework Mappings
compliance.description: Maps compliance framework names to control IDs. Most keys take a single string identifier (e.g., cis_aws_v1.4.0: "2.1.1"). The 'ccm_v4' key is special: it is a list of CCM v4 control IDs in DOMAIN-NN form (e.g., ["IAM-05", "CCC-07"]).

ccm_v4.title: CCM v4 Control Mappings
ccm_v4.description: List of CSA CCM v4 control IDs in DOMAIN-NN format (two-digit zero-padded). Absence of the field means not yet mapped; an empty list means no CCM mapping applicable. Allowed domain prefixes: AIS, A&A, BCR, CCC, CEK, DCS, DSP, GRC, HRS, IAM, IPY, IVS, LOG, SEF, STA, TVM, UEM.

params.title: Configurable Parameters
params.description: Configurable parameters referenced by value_from_param in predicate rules. Intentionally flexible (any JSON object) to support diverse parameterization patterns.

attack_stage.title: MITRE ATT&CK Stage
attack_stage.description: Canonical Stave attack stage. Closed enum aligned with docs/ontology/attack-stages.json (12 stages: 11 ATT&CK tactics plus the Stave-specific 'resilience'). Omit the field for posture / hygiene controls that do not map to a MITRE tactic.

observation_fields.title: Observation Fields
observation_fields.description: Asset property paths to include in compliance evidence records. When present, the evidence builder extracts these specific values from the snapshot for the evaluated resource.

unsafe_predicate.title: Unsafe Predicate
unsafe_predicate.description: Predicate that defines when an asset is considered unsafe. When this predicate matches, a finding is generated.

unsafe_predicate_alias.title: Unsafe Predicate Alias
unsafe_predicate_alias.description: Built-in semantic predicate alias expanded deterministically during control loading (for example: s3.is_public_readable).

exposure.title: Exposure Classification
exposure.description: Classifies who can reach the asset and how.

type.title: Exposure Type
type.description: Kind of exposure (e.g., public_read, public_write, resource_takeover).

principal_scope.title: Principal Scope
principal_scope.description: Audience that gains access (e.g., global, authenticated, cross_account).

remediation.title: Remediation Guidance
remediation.description: Guidance for remediating violations of this control.

description.title: Remediation Description
description.description: Human-readable explanation of how to fix the unsafe condition.

action.title: Remediation Action
action.description: Concrete remediation action (e.g., a CLI command, API call, or configuration change).

example.title: Remediation Example
example.description: Optional example showing the remediation action applied to a real asset.

alternatives.title: Alternative-Tool Coverage
alternatives.description: Records mapping to alternative detection tools' checks. Tool names are opaque identifiers; core code does not interpret them. Omit the field entirely when the control has no alternative-tool equivalent (Stave-unique detection).

tool.title: Alternative Tool
tool.description: Opaque identifier for an alternative detection tool (e.g., prowler, scoutsuite). Convention: lowercase, no spaces.

check_id.title: Alternative Check ID
check_id.description: The alternative tool's check identifier, verbatim from its catalog.

coverage.title: Coverage Status
coverage.description: How completely this Stave control covers the referenced alternative check. Use 'covered' for full coverage, 'partial' when a posture-policy difference or scope gap remains. Absence of an entry on any control implies the alternative check is not covered by Stave.

note.title: Coverage Note
note.description: Optional per-mapping commentary (e.g., why coverage is partial, what Stave catches that the alternative does not).

tests.title: Embedded Test Cases
tests.description: Inline test cases for verifying predicate behavior. Run with stave test.
